editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Exante scores 7.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. A legitimate multi-asset prime broker regulated by FCA, CySEC, MFSA, and SFC Hong Kong — four respected jurisdictions with real investor compensation. Over 1,000,000 instruments across 50+ global markets including stocks, ETFs with zero custody fees, 20,000+ bonds, 3,000+ futures, and options. The catch: EUR 10,000 minimum deposit for individuals and EUR 50,000 for corporates means this platform exists for professional traders and wealth managers, not retail beginners. FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 on the UK entity and ICF up to EUR 20,000 on Cyprus. MAS Singapore flagged Exante for unauthorised services — a concern but not a deal-breaker given four clean Tier-1/Tier-2 licences elsewhere. Legitimate and well-regulated — built for capital-rich professionals who need global market access in one account.
